import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if w < 4:
        print("YES")
        return
    ok = True
    while True:
        if m <= 0:
            break
        remainder = m % w
        if remainder > 1 and remainder != w - 1:
            ok = False
            break
        m = (m + 1) // w
    print("YES" if ok else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
